customManagers.description: A version in an env var under a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` comment, such as the Hearth & Hollow server pack; release tags carry a v

packageRules.description: Own images: the cooldown guards against upstream churn, which doesn't apply to self-published releases
Immich holds the family photo library, and a minor release can need a matching Postgres image, so minors get a human review; patches still automerge
BuildKit runs with Unconfined seccomp and AppArmor and must stay wire-compatible with the buildctl in the tracon-node image, so every bump gets a human review
Merging any of these restarts the Minecraft server if it is up, kicking whoever is on, so each waits for a human
The server pack: self-published, so no cooldown, but merged only once CurseForge has approved the matching client
prBodyNotes: Merge once CurseForge has approved this version of the client pack: players can only join with the same version. If the release moved NeoForge, update `NEOFORGE_VERSION` beside `PACK_VERSION` to match its `pack.toml`.

packageRules.description: GHCR never returns release timestamps and Docker Hub stops paging long tag lists (cloudflared), so under the default timestamp-required these updates stay pending forever; they skip the cooldown instead
gotk-components.yaml is generated by flux install; the flux manager bumps it through fluxcd/flux2, so per-controller image PRs would fight that
